title: Errors and panics
description: Error and critical log lines, plus Rust and Go panics, vLLM tracebacks, and OOM, across every site and stack. Panics show even when the level parse missed them.

panels.title: Errors and panics per interval, by site and container

targets.expr: sum by (openshift_labels_cluster, kubernetes_container_name) (count_over_time({log_type="application"} | regexp "(?P<panic_hit>panicked at|panic:|goroutine |Traceback|CUDA out of memory|OutOfMemoryError|OOMKilled|out of memory)" | panic_hit!="" or level=~"error|critical" [$__auto]))

panels.description: Count of matching lines per interval. A line matches when its parsed level is error or critical, or when it contains a Rust panic (panicked at), a Go panic (panic: or goroutine), a vLLM traceback (Traceback), or an out-of-memory marker. Grouped by site (openshift_labels_cluster) and container, both bounded labels.

panels.title: Matching log lines

targets.expr: {log_type="application"} | regexp "(?P<panic_hit>panicked at|panic:|goroutine |Traceback|CUDA out of memory|OutOfMemoryError|OOMKilled|out of memory)" | panic_hit!="" or level=~"error|critical"

panels.description: The matching lines themselves, newest first. Expand a line to see its site, namespace, pod, and container labels.
